text:
lara: Quick sync  planning to enable `sparrow-11b-quant` in the catalog during Thu change window (2025-08-21 04:00 UTC). Need fallback order and short rollback runbook.

ben: Which routes? public-llm and widget-embed?

lara: Yes. public-llm should get a pinned slot for 8h. widget-embed is low-priority. Also request KV prefix warm for /cache/sparrow.

deploy-bot: schedule created  sparrow-11b-quant enable: canary 5% at 1771236600, 25% at 1771238400 (10m hold), 100% at 1771242000. Fallback chain: sparrow-11b-fp16 -> comet-7b -> micro-3b. Auto-rollback triggers: p95 latency +20% OR error rate +0.8% OR smoke-eval regression >1.2%. Alerts to #eng-releases and #oncall.

ben: Prefer comet-7b before micro-3b, confirmed. Also add a 25% soft hold for manual ack.

oncall: I'm primary for the window 04:00-08:00 UTC. I'll be ready to run rollback steps: 1) drain canary, 2) revert catalog pin commit, 3) re-pin previous model, 4) cooldown 20m.

lara: Ops checklist I'll run 25m before canary: slotctl allocate public-llm 1, kv-warm --model sparrow-11b-quant --samples 2000, catalogctl pin --model sparrow-11b-quant --services public-llm,widget-embed --duration 8h.

ben: Thanks all. I'll ack the 25% hold when we hit it.
